description: Evaluation configuration. Development and unit tests use seeds below 100. A first evaluation on seeds 1000-1009 (results/run1-seeds-1000.md) exposed one weakness (outliers in zero-inflated columns) that was then fixed. A second run on seeds 2000-2009 (results/run2-seeds-2000.md) showed a 10% healthy false-positive rate caused by treating the estimated baseline outlier rate as known; the test was corrected to a two-sample comparison. A third run on seeds 3000-3009 (results/run3-seeds-3000.md) still showed false alarms from one atypical baseline because linear-scale fences sit inside the natural tail of skewed amounts; outlier fences were moved to the log scale for strictly positive skewed columns (the rule the within-version detector already used). The reported run uses the untouched seed range 4000+ and is reported as-is.
